title: 12章：月下佳人恍若梦
content_zh:
夜从边际席卷，月色与微风手牵着手滑行，能听见路边草叶子暗自低头的声音。若是在往常，河边的夜生活刚刚开始，数不清的小吃摊满目琳琅，食物的香味混合着酒香，熏得这月色都有了几分烟火味儿。

    可是如今，夷水河畔，只有无尽的冷清和死寂，似是人们发现了河中的异变，开始下意识地躲避着、远离着。

    随着三人临近河边，在月光下泛着淡淡光华的沙滩之上，一个俏丽的身影，木然地出现在三人的视线中。

    一袭白衣，染就一夜芳华，两袖月光，诉说绝世风华。

    在看清楚人影之后，张荼的目光闪过一丝欣喜和不可置信。

    可是当看到不远处的魁梧身影之时，原本欲要飞奔出去的脚步硬生生地停住。

    “姐？”

    云苍不可置信的声音响起，他的动作要比张荼慢上一拍，可是看到张荼怪异的反应之后，他亦是看到了云裳背后不远处的身影。

    晦涩难名的神色在云苍的面上一闪而过，但是仅仅是微微停顿，便是快速奔上前去，一把将眼前的佳人揽入怀中。

    感受着怀抱中微微僵硬的身躯，云苍哽咽地说道：“你去哪里了？就不能好好呆着么？你知道不知道，荼哥都快急死了。”

    张荼看着拥抱在一起的姐弟，神色从最初的平和开始变得僵硬，瞥了一眼神情全部笼罩在黑暗之中的魁梧身影，扭身便是顺着河流向着家里的方向走去。

    有些担忧，有些关怀，有些时候，不需要用言语去诉说，懂的人自然都懂。

    可是他的这般自欺欺人，又能瞒得过几人？

    随着二人的渐渐远去，边关月的声音被河风吹出了好远。

    “你当真不回头，那个姑娘，可是自从你出现之后，视线就没有转移过。”

    “你看到她身后的那个汉子了么？”张荼嘴中不冷不淡地说道。

    边关月一脸好笑，故作不知地说道：“看到了，可那又如何？”

    “那是她的未婚夫，叫刘金玉……”张荼的声音到此戛然而止。

    没有人知道他的内心是如何想的，或许此刻缥缈而来的晚风会能明白张荼的思绪。两个人的纠葛，已然扯不清楚，而若是让第三个无辜的人因此而受伤……

    张荼，不愿意。

    云家姐弟目送着二人渐行渐远的身影，脚下的影子被天空的皎月拉得很长很长，就像是张云二人心中鸿沟一般。

    云苍想不明白，为什么两个互相牵挂的人，却是始终不能跨过鸿沟走过去。

    当时那距离自己半步之遥的身影，如今可以力抗千斤的身躯，在那一瞬间竟是颤抖得厉害，以及那瞬间暴起的阴寒，若是张荼选择手刃刘金玉，云苍心想，或许我可以帮忙摁下腿吧。

    “姐，你知道不知道，哥他有多牵挂你……”

    云苍意兴阑珊的声音响起，看着不远处那如磐石一般的身影，有时候自己都对他感觉到佩服，竟然允许姐姐心中有另外一个不可剔除的男人存在，他仍是固执地选择姐姐，这都是什么人啊。
content_en:
The night sweeps from the edge, the moonlight and the breeze slide hand in hand, and you can hear the sound of the grass leaves secretly bowing their heads on the roadside. Normally, the nightlife by the river had just begun, and there were countless food stalls. The aroma of food mixed with the aroma of wine made the moonlight smell like fireworks.

    But now, along the Yishui River, there is only endless desolation and silence. It seems that people have discovered the strange changes in the river and began to subconsciously avoid and stay away.

    As the three of them approached the river, on the beach with a faint brilliance under the moonlight, a pretty figure appeared numbly in their sight.

    Wearing white clothes dyes you with a night of youthfulness, and the moonlight on your sleeves tells the story of peerless elegance.

    After seeing the figure clearly, Zhang Tu's eyes flashed with joy and disbelief.

    But when he saw the burly figure not far away, his footsteps that were about to fly out suddenly stopped.

    "Sister?"

    Yun Cang's disbelieving voice sounded. His movements were a beat slower than Zhang Tu's, but after seeing Zhang Tu's weird reaction, he also saw the figure not far behind Yun Shang.

    An obscure look flashed across Yun Cang's face, but after only a slight pause, he quickly ran forward and took the beauty in front of him into his arms.

    Feeling the slightly stiff body in his arms, Yun Cang choked and said, "Where have you been? Can't you just stay here? Do you know that Brother Tu is almost dying of anxiety?"

    Zhang Tu looked at the siblings hugging each other, his expression turned stiff from the initial peace, he glanced at the burly figure whose expression was completely shrouded in darkness, turned around and walked towards home along the river.

    Some worries, some cares, sometimes, you don’t need to express it in words, people who understand will naturally understand.

    But how many people can he deceive himself and others like this?

    As the two of them gradually moved away, Bian Guanyue's voice was blown far away by the river wind.

    "You really don't look back, girl, but your eyes haven't shifted since you appeared."

    "Did you see the man behind her?" Zhang Tu said calmly.

    Bian Guanyue looked amused, pretending not to know and said: "I saw it, but so what?"

    "That's her fiancé, his name is Liu Jinyu..." Zhang Tu's voice stopped abruptly.

    No one knows what he is thinking in his heart. Perhaps the misty evening breeze coming at this moment will be able to understand Zhang Tu's thoughts. The entanglement between the two people is already unclear, and if a third innocent person is injured because of this...

    Zhang Tu is unwilling.

    The Yun family siblings watched the two figures drifting away. The shadows under their feet were drawn very long by the bright moon in the sky, just like the gap in the hearts of Zhang Yun and Zhang Yun.

    Yun Cang couldn't understand why two people who cared about each other could never cross the gap.

    The figure that was half a step away from him at that time, now able to withstand a body weighing a thousand kilograms, was actually shaking violently at that moment, and there was a sudden burst of coldness at that moment. If Zhang Tu chose to kill Liu Jinyu with his hands, Yun Cang thought, maybe I can help press down his legs.

    "Sister, do you know how much he cares about you..."

    Yun Cang's voice of waning interest rang out. He looked at the rock-like figure not far away. Sometimes he felt admirable for him. He actually allowed his sister to have another man who couldn't be eliminated in her heart. He still stubbornly chose her. Who are these people?
title_en: Chapter 12: The beauty under the moon seems like a dream
